Town Council Agendas and Minutes are now searchable on the ClerkBase website. Certified Copies of Vital Records To obtain a certified copy of a vital record, you must provide a photo ID. Certified copies are $22 for the first copy and $18 for an additional copy of the same record. All requests for online Certified Copies of Birth/Death/Marriage Records, please click the button below: Applications and Licenses Applications and licenses are submitted to the Town Clerk's Office located in Town Hall Town Clerk's Office514 Main StreetWarren, RI 02885 For additional questions, please call 401-245-7340, ex. 4. Marriage Licenses If you live in Warren, you must obtain a marriage license from the Town Clerk's Office. If you live outside of Rhode Island, you must obtain a marriage license from the Town Clerk's Office where the ceremony will be taking place. Applications for marriage licenses will not be accepted after 3:30 PM.  Dog License All dogs in the Town of Warren must be licensed annually, from May 1st through April 30th. Please provide a current Rabies Certificate (Rabies shots can not expire before the license does, April 30th) The license fee is $6.00 per year. Other Licenses Each license listed below includes a fee and is renewed annually. For further description, please see the link below for a full schedule of license expiration dates. License Expiration Dates & Fees Looking to start a business, below are links to the Rhode Island Secretary of State's Website Business Assistant: https://www.ri.gov/SOS/businessassistant/wizard/business_categories The Business Assistant is our main tool to help new business owners get started. After answering questions about their proposed business, the user will receive a customized task list with registration instructions, professional licensing applications, state laws and regulations, additional guidance, and more. This helps entrepreneurs compile all the state-level requirements for their particular business in one, easy-to-use place. Information for Rhode Island Businesses - our main page for all for-profit entities looking to plan, start, maintain, or close their business. https://www.sos.ri.gov/divisions/business-services/ri-business Information for Non-Profit Corporations - our main page for all non-profit entities looking to plan, start, maintain, or close their organization. https://www.sos.ri.gov/divisions/business-services/non-profit Business Services email - this is the email address for anyone with questions or concerns about their new or existing business or non-profit. Corporations@sos.ri.gov  Business Registration: $25 per year, renewed annuallyBusiness Registration Application All of the license applications listed below must be approved by the Town Council. Once the Town Council approves the initial application, any renewals can be approved through the Town Clerk's Office. Class F Beverage License: $15 per event, one-day license Bowling Alley, Pool Table & Game Machine Licenses: all renewed annually Bowling Alley: $126 per year Pool Table: $200 per year Open Records Request Policy and Form Anyone who wishes to make a request for public records may do so by following the forms and procedures below. All Open Records Requests must be submitted to the: Town Clerk, Sandrea J. Speroni, CMC ssperoni@townofwarren-ri.gov Learn more about Open Government here Map Library Town maps are created and maintained by the Department of Planning and Community Development. The Department does not create custom maps for the public, but can reproduce existing maps in letter or poster size (24" x 36"). To have a map printed, the following policies apply: Prints of existing 24 X 36 maps are $10.00 per map Prints or reports on standard letter paper or 11 X 17 sheets will cost $.25 per sheet We can create a CD with digital data. The cost of the CD is $5.00 plus $25.00 per hour of staff's time We do not create custom maps. We cannot print aerial imagery for the public. For aerial images, please contact RIGIS, the state agency licensed to print aerial images. Please allow sufficient time for your requests!! Staff may not be able to handle your request immediately. Please allow 3 weeks for completion. Payment must be received PRIOR to pickup. All Town of Warren GIS disclaimers apply to digital data obtained by applicants. Prices do not include mailing and are on plain paper only (no glossy). Land Evidence Records Land Evidence Records and recorded Maps 1-688+ are found in the Town Clerk's Office. For additional questions, please call 245-7340.
